# Silicon Oasis Residences, Plot 22-018

> This mixed-use building stands on plot 22-018 in Dubai Silicon Oasis, a technology-focused free zone and residential community on the south-eastern edge of Dubai. It rises fourteen floors above ground over three basement parking levels, combining apartments on the upper floors with commercial space below. The surrounding district offers schools, clinics, parks and a retail centre within a planned urban campus served by the Dubai-Al Ain road.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This commercial and residential building in Dubai Silicon Oasis was developed by Earth Developers, part of the Al Abbas Group. It rises over three basement levels, a ground floor and fourteen upper floors combining residential and commercial space. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the building, delivering the building services across its residential and commercial areas.
